verses.en: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurados os que trilham com integridade o seu caminho, os que andam na lei do Senhor!
verses.en_web: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to Yahweh’s law.
verses.en_bbe: <ALEPH> Happy are they who are without sin in their ways, walking in the law of the Lord.

verses.en: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurados os que guardam os seus testemunhos, que o buscam de todo o coração,
verses.en_web: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
verses.en_bbe: Happy are they who keep his unchanging word, searching after him with all their heart.

verses.en: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
verses.pt: que não praticam iniqüidade, mas andam nos caminhos dele!
verses.en_web: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.
verses.en_bbe: They do no evil; they go in his ways.

verses.en: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.
verses.pt: Tu ordenaste os teus preceitos, para que fossem diligentemente observados.
verses.en_web: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.
verses.en_bbe: You have put your orders into our hearts, so that we might keep them with care.

verses.en: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!
verses.pt: Oxalá sejam os meus caminhos dirigidos de maneira que eu observe os teus estatutos!
verses.en_web: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!
verses.en_bbe: If only my ways were ordered so that I might keep your rules!

verses.en: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
verses.pt: Então não ficarei confundido, atentando para todos os teus mandamentos.
verses.en_web: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
verses.en_bbe: Then I would not be put to shame, as long as I have respect for all your teaching.

verses.en: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.
verses.pt: Louvar-te-ei com retidão de coração, quando tiver aprendido as tuas retas ordenanças.
verses.en_web: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.
verses.en_bbe: I will give you praise with an upright heart in learning your right decisions.

verses.en: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
verses.pt: Observarei os teus estatutos; não me desampares totalmente!
verses.en_web: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me.
verses.en_bbe: I will keep your rules: O give me not up completely.

verses.en: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
verses.pt: Como purificará o jovem o seu caminho? Observando-o de acordo com a tua palavra.
verses.en_web: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
verses.en_bbe: <BETH> How may a young man make his way clean? by guiding it after your word.

verses.en: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.
verses.pt: De todo o meu coração tenho te buscado; não me deixes desviar dos teus mandamentos.
verses.en_web: With my whole heart, I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
verses.en_bbe: I have made search for you with all my heart: O let me not go wandering far from your teaching.

verses.en: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
verses.pt: Escondi a tua palavra no meu coração, para não pecar contra ti.
verses.en_web: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
verses.en_bbe: I have kept your sayings secretly in my heart, so that I might do no sin against you.

verses.en: Blessed art thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.
verses.pt: Bendito és tu, ó Senhor; ensina-me os teus estatutos.
verses.en_web: Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
verses.en_bbe: Praise be to you, O Lord: give me knowledge of your rules.

verses.en: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
verses.pt: Com os meus lábios declaro todas as ordenanças da tua boca.
verses.en_web: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
verses.en_bbe: With my lips have I made clear all the decisions of your mouth.

verses.en: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.
verses.pt: Regozijo-me no caminho dos teus testemunhos, tanto como em todas as riquezas.
verses.en_web: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
verses.en_bbe: I have taken as much delight in the way of your unchanging word, as in all wealth.

verses.en: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.
verses.pt: Em teus preceitos medito, e observo os teus caminhos.
verses.en_web: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.
verses.en_bbe: I will give thought to your orders, and have respect for your ways.

verses.en: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
verses.pt: Deleitar-me-ei nos teus estatutos; não me esquecerei da tua palavra.
verses.en_web: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.
verses.en_bbe: I will have delight in your rules; I will not let your word go out of my mind.

verses.en: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.
verses.pt: Faze bem ao teu servo, para que eu viva; assim observarei a tua palavra.
verses.en_web: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.
verses.en_bbe: <GIMEL> Give me, your servant, the reward of life, so that I may keep your word;

verses.en: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
verses.pt: Desvenda os meus olhos, para que eu veja as maravilhas da tua lei.
verses.en_web: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
verses.en_bbe: Let my eyes be open to see the wonders of your law.

verses.en: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.
verses.pt: Sou peregrino na terra; não escondas de mim os teus mandamentos.
verses.en_web: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.
verses.en_bbe: I am living in a strange land: do not let your teachings be kept secret from me.

verses.en: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.
verses.pt: A minha alma se consome de anelos por tuas ordenanças em todo o tempo.
verses.en_web: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
verses.en_bbe: My soul is broken with desire for your decisions at all times.

verses.en: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.
verses.pt: Tu repreendeste os soberbos, os malditos, que se desviam dos teus mandamentos.
verses.en_web: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.
verses.en_bbe: Your hand has been against the men of pride, a curse is on those who go wandering out of your way.

verses.en: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.
verses.pt: Tira de sobre mim o opróbrio e o desprezo, pois tenho guardado os teus testemunhos.
verses.en_web: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.
verses.en_bbe: Take away from me shame and bitter words; for I have kept your unchanging word in my heart.

verses.en: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
verses.pt: Príncipes sentaram-se e falavam contra mim, mas o teu servo meditava nos teus estatutos.
verses.en_web: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.
verses.en_bbe: Rulers make evil designs against me; but your servant gives thought to your rules.

verses.en: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.
verses.pt: Os teus testemunhos são o meu prazer e os meus conselheiros.
verses.en_web: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors.
verses.en_bbe: Your unchanging word is my delight, and the guide of my footsteps.

verses.en: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.
verses.pt: A minha alma apega-se ao pó; vivifica-me segundo a tua palavra.
verses.en_web: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
verses.en_bbe: <DALETH> My soul is joined to the dust: O give me life, in keeping with your word.

verses.en: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.
verses.pt: Meus caminhos te descrevi, e tu me ouviste; ensina-me os teus estatutos.
verses.en_web: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
verses.en_bbe: I put the record of my ways before you, and you gave me an answer: O give me knowledge of your rules.

verses.en: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.
verses.pt: Faze-me entender o caminho dos teus preceitos; assim meditarei nas tuas maravilhas.
verses.en_web: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
verses.en_bbe: Make the way of your orders clear to me; then my thoughts will be ever on your wonders.

verses.en: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
verses.pt: A minha alma se consome de tristeza; fortalece-me segundo a tua palavra.
verses.en_web: My soul is weary with sorrow: strengthen me according to your word.
verses.en_bbe: My soul is wasted with sorrow; give me strength again in keeping with your word

verses.en: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.
verses.pt: Desvia de mim o caminho da falsidade, e ensina-me benignidade a tua lei.
verses.en_web: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!
verses.en_bbe: Take from me every false way; and in mercy give me your law.

verses.en: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.
verses.pt: Escolhi o caminho da fidelidade; diante de mim pus as tuas ordenanças.
verses.en_web: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.
verses.en_bbe: I have taken the way of faith: I have kept your decisions before me.

verses.en: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.
verses.pt: Apego-me aos teus testemunhos, ó Senhor; não seja eu envergonhado.
verses.en_web: I cling to your statutes, Yahweh. Don’t let me be disappointed.
verses.en_bbe: I have been true to your unchanging word; O Lord, do not put me to shame.

verses.en: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.
verses.pt: Percorrerei o caminho dos teus mandamentos, quando dilatares o meu coração.
verses.en_web: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free.
verses.en_bbe: I will go quickly in the way of your teaching, because you have given me a free heart.

verses.en: Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.
verses.pt: Ensina-me, ó Senhor, o caminho dos teus estatutos, e eu o guardarei até o fim.
verses.en_web: Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.
verses.en_bbe: <HE> O Lord, let me see the way of your rules, and I will keep it to the end.

verses.en: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
verses.pt: Dá-me entendimento, para que eu guarde a tua lei, e a observe de todo o meu coração.
verses.en_web: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
verses.en_bbe: Give me wisdom, so that I may keep your law; going after it with all my heart.

verses.en: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
verses.pt: Faze-me andar na vereda dos teus mandamentos, porque nela me comprazo.
verses.en_web: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.
verses.en_bbe: Make me go in the way of your teachings; for they are my delight.

verses.en: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.
verses.pt: Inclina o meu coração para os teus testemunhos, e não para a cobiça.
verses.en_web: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.
verses.en_bbe: Let my heart be turned to your unchanging word, and not to evil desire.

verses.en: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.
verses.pt: Desvia os meus olhos de contemplarem a vaidade, e vivifica-me no teu caminho.
verses.en_web: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
verses.en_bbe: Let my eyes be turned away from what is false; give me life in your ways.

verses.en: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.
verses.pt: Confirma a tua promessa ao teu servo, que se inclina ao teu temor.
verses.en_web: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.
verses.en_bbe: Give effect to your word to your servant, in whose heart is the fear of you.

verses.en: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.
verses.pt: Desvia de mim o opróbrio que temo, pois as tuas ordenanças são boas.
verses.en_web: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.
verses.en_bbe: Take away the shame which is my fear; for your decisions are good.

verses.en: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.
verses.pt: Eis que tenho anelado os teus preceitos; vivifica-me por tua justiça.
verses.en_web: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: See how great is my desire for your orders: give me life in your righteousness.

verses.en: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD, even thy salvation, according to thy word.
verses.pt: Venha também sobre mim a tua benignidade, ó Senhor, e a tua salvação, segundo a tua palavra.
verses.en_web: Let your loving kindness also come to me, Yahweh, your salvation, according to your word.
verses.en_bbe: <VAU> Let your mercies come to me, O Lord, even your salvation, as you have said.

verses.en: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.
verses.pt: Assim terei o que responder ao que me afronta, pois confio na tua palavra.
verses.en_web: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.
verses.en_bbe: So that I may have an answer for the man who would put me to shame; for I have faith in your word.

verses.en: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.
verses.pt: De minha boca não tires totalmente a palavra da verdade, pois tenho esperado nos teus juízos.
verses.en_web: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.
verses.en_bbe: Take not your true word quite out of my mouth; for I have put my hope in your decisions.

verses.en: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.
verses.pt: Assim observarei de contínuo a tua lei, para sempre e eternamente;
verses.en_web: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.
verses.en_bbe: So that I may keep your law for ever and ever;

verses.en: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.
verses.pt: e andarei em liberdade, pois tenho buscado os teus preceitos.
verses.en_web: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.
verses.en_bbe: So that my way may be in a wide place: because my search has been for your orders.

verses.en: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
verses.pt: Falarei dos teus testemunhos perante os reis, e não me envergonharei.
verses.en_web: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
verses.en_bbe: So that I may give knowledge of your unchanging word before kings, and not be put to shame.

verses.en: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.
verses.pt: Deleitar-me-ei em teus mandamentos, que eu amo.
verses.en_web: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.
verses.en_bbe: And so that I may take delight in your teachings, to which I have given my love.

verses.en: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.
verses.pt: Também levantarei as minhas mãos para os teus mandamentos, que amo, e meditarei nos teus estatutos.
verses.en_web: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.
verses.en_bbe: And so that my hands may be stretched out to you; and I will give thought to your rules.

verses.en: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
verses.pt: Lembra-te da palavra dada ao teu servo, na qual me fizeste esperar.
verses.en_web: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.
verses.en_bbe: <ZAIN> Keep in mind your word to your servant, for on it has my hope been fixed.

verses.en: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
verses.pt: Isto é a minha consolação na minha angústia, que a tua promessa me vivifica.
verses.en_web: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.
verses.en_bbe: This is my comfort in my trouble; that your sayings have given me life.

verses.en: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.
verses.pt: Os soberbos zombaram grandemente de mim; contudo não me desviei da tua lei.
verses.en_web: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.
verses.en_bbe: The men of pride have made great sport of me; but I have not been turned from your law.

verses.en: I remembered thy judgments of old, O LORD; and have comforted myself.
verses.pt: Lembro-me dos teus juízos antigos, ó Senhor, e assim me consolo.
verses.en_web: I remember your ordinances of old, Yahweh, and have comforted myself.
verses.en_bbe: I have kept the memory of your decisions from times past, O Lord; and they have been my comfort.

verses.en: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
verses.pt: Grande indignação apoderou-se de mim, por causa dos ímpios que abandonam a tua lei.
verses.en_web: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.
verses.en_bbe: I am burning with wrath, because of the sinners who have given up your law.

verses.en: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
verses.pt: Os teus estatutos têm sido os meus cânticos na casa da minha peregrinação.
verses.en_web: Your statutes have been my songs, in the house where I live.
verses.en_bbe: Your rules have been melodies to me, while I have been living in strange lands.

verses.en: I have remembered thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept thy law.
verses.pt: De noite me lembrei do teu nome, ó Senhor, e observei a tua lei.
verses.en_web: I have remembered your name, Yahweh, in the night, and I obey your law.
verses.en_bbe: I have given thought to your name in the night, O Lord, and have kept your law.

verses.en: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
verses.pt: Isto me sucedeu, porque tenho guardado os teus preceitos.
verses.en_web: This is my way, that I keep your precepts.
verses.en_bbe: This has been true of me, that I have kept your orders in my heart.

verses.en: Thou art my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.
verses.pt: O Senhor é o meu quinhão; prometo observar as tuas palavras.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
verses.en_bbe: <CHETH> The Lord is my heritage: I have said that I would be ruled by your words.

verses.en: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.
verses.pt: De todo o meu coração imploro o teu favor; tem piedade de mim, segundo a tua palavra.
verses.en_web: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.
verses.en_bbe: I have given my mind to do your pleasure with all my heart; have mercy on me, as you have said.

verses.en: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
verses.pt: Quando considero os meus caminhos, volto os meus pés para os teus testemunhos.
verses.en_web: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.
verses.en_bbe: I gave thought to my steps, and my feet were turned into the way of your unchanging word.

verses.en: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.
verses.pt: Apresso-me sem detença a observar os teus mandamentos.
verses.en_web: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.
verses.en_bbe: I was quick to do your orders, and let no time be wasted.

verses.en: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.
verses.pt: Enleiam-me os laços dos ímpios; mas eu não me esqueço da tua lei.
verses.en_web: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.
verses.en_bbe: The cords of evil-doers are round me; but I have kept in mind your law.

verses.en: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.
verses.pt: Â meia-noite me levanto para dar-te graças, por causa dos teus retos juízos.
verses.en_web: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.
verses.en_bbe: In the middle of the night I will get up to give you praise, because of all your right decisions.

verses.en: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
verses.pt: Companheiro sou de todos os que te temem, e dos que guardam os teus preceitos.
verses.en_web: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.
verses.en_bbe: I keep company with all your worshippers, and those who have your orders in their memory.

verses.en: The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.
verses.pt: A terra, ó Senhor, está cheia da tua benignidade; ensina-me os teus estatutos.
verses.en_web: The earth is full of your loving kindness, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
verses.en_bbe: The earth, O Lord, is full of your mercy: give me knowledge of your rules.

verses.en: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.
verses.pt: Tens usado de bondade para com o teu servo, Senhor, segundo a tua palavra.
verses.en_web: Do good to your servant, according to your word, Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: <TETH> You have done good to your servant, O Lord, in keeping with your word.

verses.en: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.
verses.pt: Ensina-me bom juízo e ciência, pois creio nos teus mandamentos.
verses.en_web: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.
verses.en_bbe: Give me knowledge and good sense; for I have put my faith in your teachings.

verses.en: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.
verses.pt: Antes de ser afligido, eu me extraviava; mas agora guardo a tua palavra.
verses.en_web: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.
verses.en_bbe: Before I was in trouble I went out of the way; but now I keep your word.

verses.en: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
verses.pt: Tu és bom e fazes o bem; ensina-me os teus estatutos.
verses.en_web: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.
verses.en_bbe: You are good, and your works are good; give me knowledge of your rules.

verses.en: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.
verses.pt: Os soberbos forjam mentiras contra mim; mas eu de todo o coração guardo os teus preceitos.
verses.en_web: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.
verses.en_bbe: The men of pride have said false things about me; but I will keep your orders in my heart.

verses.en: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.
verses.pt: Torna-se-lhes insensível o coração como a gordura; mas eu me deleito na tua lei.
verses.en_web: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.
verses.en_bbe: Their hearts are shut up with fat; but my delight is in your law.

verses.en: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
verses.pt: Foi-me bom ter sido afligido, para que aprendesse os teus estatutos.
verses.en_web: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
verses.en_bbe: It is good for me to have been through trouble; so that I might come to the knowledge of your rules.

verses.en: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
verses.pt: Melhor é para mim a lei da tua boca do que milhares de ouro e prata.
verses.en_web: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
verses.en_bbe: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver.

verses.en: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
verses.pt: As tuas mãos me fizeram e me formaram; dá-me entendimento para que aprenda os teus mandamentos.
verses.en_web: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.
verses.en_bbe: <JOD> Your hands have made me, and given me form: give me wisdom, so that I may have knowledge of your teaching.

verses.en: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.
verses.pt: Os que te temem me verão e se alegrarão, porque tenho esperado na tua palavra.
verses.en_web: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.
verses.en_bbe: Your worshippers will see me and be glad; because my hope has been in your word.

verses.en: I know, O LORD, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
verses.pt: Bem sei eu, ó Senhor, que os teus juízos são retos, e que em tua fidelidade me afligiste.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
verses.en_bbe: I have seen, O Lord, that your decisions are right, and that in unchanging faith you have sent trouble on me.

verses.en: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
verses.pt: Sirva, pois, a tua benignidade para me consolar, segundo a palavra que deste ao teu servo.
verses.en_web: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
verses.en_bbe: Let your mercy now be my comfort, as you have said to your servant.

verses.en: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.
verses.pt: Venham sobre mim as tuas ternas misericórdias, para que eu viva, pois a tua lei é o meu deleite.
verses.en_web: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.
verses.en_bbe: Let your gentle mercies come to me, so that I may have life; for your law is my delight.

verses.en: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.
verses.pt: Envergonhados sejam os soberbos, por me haverem subvertido sem causa; mas eu meditarei nos teus preceitos.
verses.en_web: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.
verses.en_bbe: Let the men of pride be shamed; because they have falsely given decision against me; but I will give thought to your orders.

verses.en: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.
verses.pt: Voltem-se para mim os que te temem, para que conheçam os teus testemunhos.
verses.en_web: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.
verses.en_bbe: Let your worshippers be turned to me, and those who have knowledge of your words.

verses.en: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.
verses.pt: Seja perfeito o meu coração nos teus estatutos, para que eu não seja envergonhado.
verses.en_web: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed.
verses.en_bbe: Let all my heart be given to your orders, so that I may not be put to shame.

verses.en: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.
verses.pt: Desfalece a minha alma, aguardando a tua salvação; espero na tua palavra.
verses.en_web: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
verses.en_bbe: <CAPH> My soul is wasted with desire for your salvation: but I have hope in your word.

verses.en: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
verses.pt: Os meus olhos desfalecem, esperando por tua promessa, enquanto eu pergunto: Quando me consolarás tu?
verses.en_web: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”
verses.en_bbe: My eyes are full of weariness with searching for your word, saying, When will you give me comfort?

verses.en: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.
verses.pt: Pois tornei-me como odre na fumaça, mas não me esqueci dos teus estatutos.
verses.en_web: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.
verses.en_bbe: For I have become like a wine-skin black with smoke; but I still keep the memory of your rules.

verses.en: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
verses.pt: Quantos serão os dias do teu servo? Até quando não julgarás aqueles que me perseguem?
verses.en_web: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?
verses.en_bbe: How short is the life of your servant! when will you give your decision against those who are attacking me?

verses.en: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.
verses.pt: Abriram covas para mim os soberbos, que não andam segundo a tua lei.
verses.en_web: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.
verses.en_bbe: The men of pride, who are turned away from your law, have put nets for me.

verses.en: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
verses.pt: Todos os teus mandamentos são fiéis. Sou perseguido injustamente; ajuda-me!
verses.en_web: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
verses.en_bbe: All your teachings are certain; they go after me with evil design; give me your help.

verses.en: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.
verses.pt: Quase que me consumiram sobre a terra, mas eu não deixei os teus preceitos.
verses.en_web: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.
verses.en_bbe: They had almost put an end to me on earth; but I did not give up your orders.

verses.en: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
verses.pt: Vivifica-me segundo a tua benignidade, para que eu guarde os testemunhos da tua boca.
verses.en_web: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth.
verses.en_bbe: Give me life in your mercy; so that I may be ruled by the unchanging word of your mouth.

verses.en: For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.
verses.pt: Para sempre, ó Senhor, a tua palavra está firmada nos céus.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, your word is settled in heaven forever.
verses.en_bbe: <LAMED> For ever, O Lord, your word is fixed in heaven.

verses.en: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
verses.pt: A tua fidelidade estende-se de geração a geração; tu firmaste a terra, e firme permanece.
verses.en_web: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.
verses.en_bbe: Your faith is unchanging from generation to generation: you have put the earth in its place, and it is not moved.

verses.en: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.
verses.pt: Conforme a tua ordenança, tudo se mantém até hoje, porque todas as coisas te obedecem.
verses.en_web: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.
verses.en_bbe: They are ruled this day by your decisions; for all things are your servants.

verses.en: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
verses.pt: Se a tua lei não fora o meu deleite, então eu teria perecido na minha angústia.
verses.en_web: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
verses.en_bbe: If your law had not been my delight, my troubles would have put an end to me.

verses.en: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.
verses.pt: Nunca me esquecerei dos teus preceitos, pois por eles me tens vivificado.
verses.en_web: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.
verses.en_bbe: I will ever keep your orders in mind; for in them I have life.

verses.en: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
verses.pt: Sou teu, salva-me; pois tenho buscado os teus preceitos.
verses.en_web: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.
verses.en_bbe: I am yours, O be my saviour; for my desire has been for your rules.

verses.en: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.
verses.pt: Os ímpios me espreitam para me destruírem, mas eu atento para os teus testemunhos.
verses.en_web: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.
verses.en_bbe: The sinners have been waiting for me to give me up to destruction; but I will give all my mind to your unchanging ward.

verses.en: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.
verses.pt: A toda perfeição vi limite, mas o teu mandamento é ilimitado.
verses.en_web: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless.
verses.en_bbe: I have seen that nothing on earth is complete; but your teaching is very wide.

verses.en: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
verses.pt: Oh! quanto amo a tua lei! ela é a minha meditação o dia todo.
verses.en_web: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
verses.en_bbe: <MEM> O what love I have for your law! I give thought to it all the day.

verses.en: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.
verses.pt: O teu mandamento me faz mais sábio do que meus inimigos, pois está sempre comigo.
verses.en_web: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.
verses.en_bbe: Your teaching has made me wiser than my haters: for it is mine for ever.

verses.en: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.
verses.pt: Tenho mais entendimento do que todos os meus mestres, porque os teus testemunhos são a minha meditação.
verses.en_web: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.
verses.en_bbe: I have more knowledge than all my teachers, because I give thought to your unchanging word.

verses.en: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
verses.pt: Sou mais entendido do que os velhos, porque tenho guardado os teus preceitos.
verses.en_web: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.
verses.en_bbe: I have more wisdom than the old, because I have kept your orders.

verses.en: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.
verses.pt: Retenho os meus pés de todo caminho mau, a fim de observar a tua palavra.
verses.en_web: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.
verses.en_bbe: I have kept back my feet from all evil ways, so that I might be true to your word.

verses.en: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.
verses.pt: Não me aperto das tuas ordenanças, porque és tu quem me instrui.
verses.en_web: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.
verses.en_bbe: My heart has not been turned away from your decisions; for you have been my teacher.

verses.en: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.pt: Oh! quão doces são as tuas palavras ao meu paladar! mais doces do que o mel à minha boca.
verses.en_web: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
verses.en_bbe: How sweet are your sayings to my taste! truly, they are sweeter than honey in my mouth!

verses.en: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
verses.pt: Pelos teus preceitos alcanço entendimento, pelo que aborreço toda vereda de falsidade.
verses.en_web: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.
verses.en_bbe: Through your orders I get wisdom; for this reason I am a hater of every false way.

verses.en: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verses.pt: Lâmpada para os meus pés é a tua palavra, e luz para o meu caminho.
verses.en_web: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
verses.en_bbe: <NUN> Your word is a light for my feet, ever shining on my way.

verses.en: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
verses.pt: Fiz juramento, e o confirmei, de guardar as tuas justas ordenanças.
verses.en_web: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
verses.en_bbe: I have made an oath and kept it, to be guided by your upright decisions.

verses.en: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according unto thy word.
verses.pt: Estou aflitíssimo; vivifica-me, ó Senhor, segundo a tua palavra.
verses.en_web: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your word.
verses.en_bbe: I am greatly troubled, O Lord, give me life in keeping with your word.

verses.en: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.
verses.pt: Aceita, Senhor, eu te rogo, as oferendas voluntárias da minha boca, e ensina-me as tuas ordenanças.
verses.en_web: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. Yahweh, teach me your ordinances.
verses.en_bbe: Take, O Lord, the free offerings of my mouth, and give me knowledge of your decisions.

verses.en: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.
verses.pt: Estou continuamente em perigo de vida; todavia não me esqueço da tua lei.
verses.en_web: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.
verses.en_bbe: My soul is ever in danger; but I still keep the memory of your law.

verses.en: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.
verses.pt: Os ímpios me armaram laço, contudo não me desviei dos teus preceitos.
verses.en_web: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.
verses.en_bbe: Sinners have put a net to take me; but I was true to your orders.

verses.en: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
verses.pt: Os teus testemunhos são a minha herança para sempre, pois são eles o gozo do meu coração.
verses.en_web: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
verses.en_bbe: I have taken your unchanging word as an eternal heritage; for it is the joy of my heart.

verses.en: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.
verses.pt: Inclino o meu coração a cumprir os teus estatutos, para sempre, até o fim.
verses.en_web: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end.
verses.en_bbe: My heart is ever ready to keep your rules, even to the end.

verses.en: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
verses.pt: Aborreço a duplicidade, mas amo a tua lei.
verses.en_web: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.
verses.en_bbe: <SAMECH> I am a hater of men of doubting mind; but I am a lover of your law.

verses.en: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
verses.pt: Tu és o meu refúgio e o meu escudo; espero na tua palavra.
verses.en_web: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.
verses.en_bbe: You are my secret place and my breastplate against danger; my hope is in your word.

verses.en: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.
verses.pt: Apartai-vos de mim, malfeitores, para que eu guarde os mandamentos do meu Deus.
verses.en_web: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
verses.en_bbe: Go far from me, you evil-doers; so that I may keep the teachings of my God.

verses.en: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
verses.pt: Ampara-me conforme a tua palavra, para que eu viva; e não permitas que eu seja envergonhado na minha esperança.
verses.en_web: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
verses.en_bbe: Be my support as you have said, and give me life; let not my hope be turned to shame.

verses.en: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
verses.pt: Sustenta-me, e serei salvo, e de contínuo terei respeito aos teus estatutos.
verses.en_web: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
verses.en_bbe: Let me not be moved, and I will be safe, and ever take delight in your rules.

verses.en: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
verses.pt: Desprezas todos os que se desviam dos teus estatutos, pois a astúcia deles é falsidade.
verses.en_web: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.
verses.en_bbe: You have overcome all those who are wandering from your rules; for all their thoughts are false.

verses.en: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.
verses.pt: Deitas fora, como escória, todos os ímpios da terra; pelo que amo os teus testemunhos.
verses.en_web: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.
verses.en_bbe: All the sinners of the earth are like waste metal in your eyes; and for this cause I give my love to your unchanging word.

verses.en: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.
verses.pt: Arrepia-se-me a carne com temor de ti, e tenho medo dos teus juízos.
verses.en_web: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.
verses.en_bbe: My flesh is moved for fear of you; I give honour to your decisions.

verses.en: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.
verses.pt: Tenho praticado a retidão e a justiça; não me abandones aos meus opressores.
verses.en_web: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.
verses.en_bbe: <AIN> I have done what is good and right: you will not give me into the hands of those who are working against me.

verses.en: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
verses.pt: Fica por fiador do teu servo para o bem; não me oprimem os soberbos.
verses.en_web: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.
verses.en_bbe: Take your servant's interests into your keeping; let me not be crushed by the men of pride.

verses.en: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.
verses.pt: Os meus olhos desfalecem à espera da tua salvação e da promessa da tua justiça.
verses.en_web: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.
verses.en_bbe: My eyes are wasted with desire for your salvation, and for the word of your righteousness.

verses.en: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.
verses.pt: Trata com o teu servo segundo a tua benignidade, e ensina-me os teus estatutos.
verses.en_web: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.
verses.en_bbe: Be good to your servant in your mercy, and give me teaching in your rules.

verses.en: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.
verses.pt: Sou teu servo; dá-me entendimento, para que eu conheça os teus testemunhos.
verses.en_web: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.
verses.en_bbe: I am your servant; give me wisdom, so that I may have knowledge of your unchanging word.

verses.en: It is time for thee, LORD, to work: for they have made void thy law.
verses.pt: É tempo de agires, ó Senhor, pois eles violaram a tua lei.
verses.en_web: It is time to act, Yahweh, for they break your law.
verses.en_bbe: It is time, O Lord, for you to let your work be seen; for they have made your law without effect.

verses.en: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
verses.pt: Pelo que amo os teus mandamentos mais do que o ouro, sim, mais do que o ouro fino.
verses.en_web: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason I have greater love far your teachings than for gold, even for shining gold.

verses.en: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.
verses.pt: Por isso dirijo os meus passos por todos os teus preceitos, e aborreço toda vereda de falsidade.
verses.en_web: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
verses.en_bbe: Because of it I keep straight in all things by your orders; and I am a hater of every false way.

verses.en: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
verses.pt: Maravilhosos são os teus testemunhos, por isso a minha alma os guarda.
verses.en_web: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.
verses.en_bbe: <PE> Your unchanging word is full of wonder; for this reason my soul keeps it.

verses.en: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
verses.pt: A exposição das tuas palavras dá luz; dá entendimento aos simples.
verses.en_web: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.
verses.en_bbe: The opening of your words gives light; it gives good sense to the simple.

verses.en: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
verses.pt: Abro a minha boca e arquejo, pois estou anelante pelos teus mandamentos.
verses.en_web: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.
verses.en_bbe: My mouth was open wide, waiting with great desire for your teachings.

verses.en: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
verses.pt: Volta-te para mim, e compadece-te de mim, conforme usas para com os que amam o teu nome.
verses.en_web: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
verses.en_bbe: Let your eyes be turned to me, and have mercy on me, as it is right for you to do to those who are lovers of your name.

verses.en: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.pt: Firma os meus passos na tua palavra; e não se apodere de mim iniqüidade alguma.
verses.en_web: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.en_bbe: Let my steps be guided by your word; and let not sin have control over me.

verses.en: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
verses.pt: Resgata-me da opressão do homem; assim guardarei os teus preceitos.
verses.en_web: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.
verses.en_bbe: Make me free from the cruel rule of man; then I will keep your orders.

verses.en: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.
verses.pt: Faze resplandecer o teu rosto sobre o teu servo, e ensina-me os teus estatutos.
verses.en_web: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.
verses.en_bbe: Let your servant see the shining of your face; give me knowledge of your rules.

verses.en: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.
verses.pt: Os meus olhos derramam rios de lágrimas, porque os homens não guardam a tua lei.
verses.en_web: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law.
verses.en_bbe: Rivers of water are flowing from my eyes, because men do not keep your law.

verses.en: Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.
verses.pt: Justo és, ó Senhor, e retos são os teus juízos.
verses.en_web: You are righteous, Yahweh. Your judgments are upright.
verses.en_bbe: <TZADE> O Lord, great is your righteousness, and upright are your decisions.

verses.en: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.
verses.pt: Ordenaste os teus testemunhos com retidão, e com toda a fidelidade.
verses.en_web: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.
verses.en_bbe: You have given your unchanging word in righteousness, and it is for ever.

verses.en: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
verses.pt: O meu zelo me consome, porque os meus inimigos se esquecem da tua palavra.
verses.en_web: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.
verses.en_bbe: My passion has overcome me; because my haters are turned away from your words.

verses.en: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
verses.pt: A tua palavra é fiel a toda prova, por isso o teu servo a ama.
verses.en_web: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.
verses.en_bbe: Your word is of tested value; and it is dear to your servant.

verses.en: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.
verses.pt: Pequeno sou e desprezado, mas não me esqueço dos teus preceitos.
verses.en_web: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.
verses.en_bbe: I am small and of no account; but I keep your orders in mind.

verses.en: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.
verses.pt: A tua justiça é justiça eterna, e a tua lei é a verdade.
verses.en_web: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.
verses.en_bbe: Your righteousness is an unchanging righteousness, and your law is certain.

verses.en: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.
verses.pt: Tribulação e angústia se apoderaram de mim; mas os teus mandamentos são o meu prazer.
verses.en_web: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.
verses.en_bbe: Pain and trouble have overcome me: but your teachings are my delight.

verses.en: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
verses.pt: Justos são os teus testemunhos para sempre; dá-me entendimento, para que eu viva.
verses.en_web: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.
verses.en_bbe: The righteousness of your unchanging word is eternal; give me wisdom so that I may have life.

verses.en: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.
verses.pt: Clamo de todo o meu coração; atende-me, Senhor! Eu guardarei os teus estatutos.
verses.en_web: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, Yahweh! I will keep your statutes.
verses.en_bbe: <KOPH> I have made my prayer with all my heart; give answer to me, O Lord: I will keep your rules.

verses.en: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
verses.pt: A ti clamo; salva-me, para que guarde os teus testemunhos.
verses.en_web: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.
verses.en_bbe: My cry has gone up to you; take me out of trouble, and I will be guided by your unchanging word.

verses.en: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
verses.pt: Antecipo-me à alva da manhã e clamo; aguardo com esperança as tuas palavras.
verses.en_web: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.
verses.en_bbe: Before the sun is up, my cry for help comes to your ear; my hope is in your words.

verses.en: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
verses.pt: Os meus olhos se antecipam às vigílias da noite, para que eu medite na tua palavra.
verses.en_web: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
verses.en_bbe: In the night watches I am awake, so that I may give thought to your saying.

verses.en: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.
verses.pt: Ouve a minha voz, segundo a tua benignidade; vivifica-me, ó Senhor, segundo a tua justiça.
verses.en_web: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your ordinances.
verses.en_bbe: Let my voice come to you, in your mercy; O Lord, by your decisions give me life.

verses.en: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
verses.pt: Aproximam-se os que me perseguem maliciosamente; andam afastados da tua lei.
verses.en_web: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.
verses.en_bbe: Those who have evil designs against me come near; they are far from your law.

verses.en: Thou art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments are truth.
verses.pt: Tu estás perto, Senhor, e todos os teus mandamentos são verdade.
verses.en_web: You are near, Yahweh. All your commandments are truth.
verses.en_bbe: You are near, O Lord; and all your teachings are true.

verses.en: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
verses.pt: Há muito sei eu dos teus testemunhos que os fundaste para sempre.
verses.en_web: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever.
verses.en_bbe: I have long had knowledge that your unchanging word is for ever.

verses.en: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
verses.pt: Olha para a minha aflição, e livra-me, pois não me esqueço da tua lei.
verses.en_web: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.
verses.en_bbe: <RESH> O see my trouble, and be my saviour; for I keep your law in my mind,

verses.en: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.
verses.pt: Pleiteia a minha causa, e resgata-me; vivifica-me segundo a tua palavra.
verses.en_web: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.
verses.en_bbe: Undertake my cause, and come to my help, give me life, as you have said.

verses.en: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
verses.pt: A salvação está longe dos ímpios, pois não buscam os teus estatutos.
verses.en_web: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.
verses.en_bbe: Salvation is far from evil-doers; for they have made no search for your rules.

verses.en: Great are thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments.
verses.pt: Muitas são, Senhor, as tuas misericórdias; vivifica-me segundo os teus juízos.
verses.en_web: Great are your tender mercies, Yahweh. Revive me according to your ordinances.
verses.en_bbe: Great is the number of your mercies, O Lord; give me life in keeping with your decisions.

verses.en: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.
verses.pt: Muitos são os meus perseguidores e os meus adversários, mas não me desvio dos teus testemunhos.
verses.en_web: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.
verses.en_bbe: Great is the number of those who are against me; but I have not been turned away from your unchanging word.

verses.en: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
verses.pt: Vi os pérfidos, e me afligi, porque não guardam a tua palavra.
verses.en_web: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.
verses.en_bbe: I saw with hate those who were untrue to you; for they did not keep your saying.

verses.en: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.
verses.pt: Considera como amo os teus preceitos; vivifica-me, Senhor, segundo a tua benignidade.
verses.en_web: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.
verses.en_bbe: See how great is my love for your orders: give me life, O Lord, in keeping with your mercy.

verses.en: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.
verses.pt: A soma da tua palavra é a verdade, e cada uma das tuas justas ordenanças dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever.
verses.en_bbe: Your word is true from the first; and your upright decision is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
verses.pt: Príncipes me perseguem sem causa, mas o meu coração teme as tuas palavras.
verses.en_web: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.
verses.en_bbe: <SHIN> Rulers have been cruel to me without cause; but I have the fear of your word in my heart.

verses.en: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
verses.pt: Regozijo-me com a tua palavra, como quem acha grande despojo.
verses.en_web: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
verses.en_bbe: I am delighted by your saying, like a man who makes discovery of great wealth.

verses.en: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
verses.pt: Odeio e abomino a falsidade; amo, porém, a tua lei.
verses.en_web: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.
verses.en_bbe: I am full of hate and disgust for false words; but I am a lover of your law.

verses.en: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
verses.pt: Sete vezes no dia te louvo pelas tuas justas ordenanças.
verses.en_web: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.
verses.en_bbe: Seven times a day do I give you praise, because of your upright decisions.

verses.en: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
verses.pt: Muita paz têm os que amam a tua lei, e não há nada que os faça tropeçar.
verses.en_web: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.
verses.en_bbe: Great peace have lovers of your law; they have no cause for falling.

verses.en: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
verses.pt: Espero, Senhor, na tua salvação, e cumpro os teus mandamentos.
verses.en_web: I have hoped for your salvation, Yahweh. I have done your commandments.
verses.en_bbe: Lord, my hope has been in your salvation; and I have kept your teachings.

verses.en: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
verses.pt: A minha alma observa os teus testemunhos; amo-os extremamente.
verses.en_web: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.
verses.en_bbe: My soul has kept your unchanging word; great is my love for it.

verses.en: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.
verses.pt: Observo os teus preceitos e os teus testemunhos, pois todos os meus caminhos estão diante de ti.
verses.en_web: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you.
verses.en_bbe: I have been ruled by your orders; for all my ways are before you.

verses.en: Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.
verses.pt: Chegue a ti o meu clamor, ó Senhor; dá-me entendimento conforme a tua palavra.
verses.en_web: Let my cry come before you, Yahweh. Give me understanding according to your word.
verses.en_bbe: <TAU> Let my cry come before you, O Lord; give me wisdom in keeping with your word.

verses.en: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
verses.pt: Chegue à tua presença a minha súplica; livra-me segundo a tua palavra.
verses.en_web: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.
verses.en_bbe: Let my prayer come before you; take me out of trouble, as you have said.

verses.en: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
verses.pt: Profiram louvor os meus lábios, pois me ensinas os teus estatutos.
verses.en_web: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.
verses.en_bbe: Let my lips be flowing with praise, because you have given me knowledge of your rules.

verses.en: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.
verses.pt: Celebre a minha língua a tua palavra, pois todos os teus mandamentos são justos.
verses.en_web: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: Let my tongue make songs in praise of your word; for all your teachings are righteousness.

verses.en: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
verses.pt: Esteja pronta a tua mão para me socorrer, pois escolhi os teus preceitos.
verses.en_web: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
verses.en_bbe: Let your hand be near for my help; for I have given my heart to your orders.

verses.en: I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law is my delight.
verses.pt: Anelo por tua salvação, ó Senhor; a tua lei é o meu prazer.
verses.en_web: I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.
verses.en_bbe: All my desire has been for your salvation, O Lord; and your law is my delight.

verses.en: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
verses.pt: Que minha alma viva, para que te louve; ajudem-me as tuas ordenanças.
verses.en_web: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.
verses.en_bbe: Give life to my soul so that it may give you praise; and let your decisions be my support.

verses.en: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
verses.pt: Desgarrei-me como ovelha perdida; busca o teu servo, pois não me esqueço dos teus mandamentos.
verses.en_web: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
verses.en_bbe: I have gone out of the way like a wandering sheep; make search for your servant; for I keep your teachings ever in mind.
